claims.claim: Q2 2026 U.S. adjusted retail e-commerce sales were $340.2B, 17.1% of total retail, but Census flagged the release as no longer containing the latest estimates as of 2026-09-28.
claims.counterevidence: The figures are pending revision in the Q3 2026 release.

claims.claim: Census store-industry e-commerce ratios should not be treated as product-category online penetration because separate e-commerce divisions can be classified in NAICS 4541.
claims.counterevidence: A product-based commercial dataset could still measure category online penetration accurately; Census store-type tables do not.

claims.claim: Among relatively target-adjacent public U.S. dollar baselines, C16 is clearly larger than C13, C18 and C14; C13 and C18 are both tens-of-billions markets and C14 is also large.
claims.counterevidence: The four sources use different category boundaries, years and retail/PCE definitions, so only coarse ordering is defensible.

claims.claim: U.S. consumer technology revenue was forecast at $112B for 2026, with computers contributing over $600M of incremental revenue and tablets over $200M.
claims.counterevidence: This is a January forecast, not realized full-year sales; later tablet shipment data deteriorated sharply.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 U.S. smartphone sell-in and sell-through moved in opposite directions: shipments rose 6% YoY while consumer sales fell 5% YoY.
claims.counterevidence: Different trackers/methodologies measure different channel stages, so the exact magnitude is not directly comparable.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 U.S. PC shipments rose only 1.0%, while market revenue rose 13.1% and sell-in ASP exceeded $1,000, demonstrating strong price/mix effects.
claims.counterevidence: PC data includes commercial demand and desktops/workstations, not only consumer laptops.

claims.claim: U.S. tablet shipments fell 31.6% YoY in Q2 2026, contradicting a simple interpretation of early-2026 revenue-growth forecasts.
claims.counterevidence: Revenue can rise even if units fall when ASP rises; forecast and shipment measures are not identical.

claims.claim: CTA has a potentially decisive product-level U.S. technology dataset covering shipments, wholesale revenue, average wholesale price and household penetration, but the complete report requires authenticated/paid access.
claims.counterevidence: CTA measures wholesale revenue, so even authenticated data would still require a retail/PCE crosswalk.

claims.claim: Circana's 2026 Home forecast shows dollar growth to $43.7B despite pressured unit demand, reinforcing the need to separate dollar demand from units.
claims.counterevidence: The Circana Home universe overlaps C10 and C17 and is not identical to either target category.

claims.claim: The U.S. toy market has unusually strong current momentum: H1 2026 dollars +17%, units +12%, ASP +4%, with licensed toys 39% of sales.
claims.counterevidence: Trading cards and collectibles are major growth drivers and may make the current period atypical.

claims.claim: The current CIPA official page reviewed in this continuation verifies digital-camera statistics through June 2026, published August 3, 2026; it does not by itself provide U.S. retail GMV.
claims.counterevidence: A newer file may exist outside the currently indexed/public page, but it was not verified in this session.

claims.claim: A complete 1-18 numeric demand ranking is not currently supportable without manufacturing weights for missing categories.
claims.counterevidence: Authenticated CTA/Circana/IDC product-level data could materially close the missing-data problem.

categories.name: Smartphones
categories.metric: BEA PCE proxy: telephone and related communication equipment
categories.latest_signal: Q2 2026 shipments +6% YoY; consumer sales -5% YoY
categories.concentration: Q2 2026 shipment share Apple 54%, Samsung 30%, Motorola 11%
categories.limitations: PCE proxy is broader than smartphones; sell-in differs from sell-through

categories.name: Laptops
categories.latest_signal: Q2 2026 U.S. PCs excluding tablets: 18.8M shipments, +1.0% YoY; consumer +2.8%
categories.limitations: PC figures combine notebooks, desktops and workstations; consumer/commercial mixed

categories.name: Tablets
categories.concentration: Global top five vendors 79.8%, not U.S.-specific
categories.limitations: January revenue forecast conflicted with later shipment weakness

categories.name: Mini PCs / small desktops
categories.latest_signal: IDC identifies low-cost mini-PCs as competition for sub-$200 tablets
categories.limitations: No U.S. mini-PC market-size series found

categories.name: PC components / storage / networking
categories.metric: BEA information-processing equipment $326.628B is only a broad shared upper proxy
categories.concentration: Enthusiast community shows multi-retailer purchasing; not quantifiable
categories.limitations: Broad proxy overlaps C02/C03/C04/C07; authenticated CTA data required

categories.name: Headphones / IEM / DAC / portable audio
categories.metric: BEA video and audio equipment $92.593B is a broad upper proxy
categories.latest_signal: Wired headphone 2025 revenue +3%; first six weeks 2026 +20%
categories.limitations: BEA bucket includes substantial video products; Circana signal covers headphones only

categories.name: PC peripherals
categories.concentration: Multi-retailer behavior visible in enthusiast community
categories.limitations: AUTHENTICATED DATA REQUIRED for product-level CTA values

categories.name: Wearables
categories.latest_signal: Jan-Jul 2025 >1.3M fitness trackers; revenue +88%; smart-ring revenue $217M
categories.limitations: Does not include full smartwatch market

categories.name: Smart home / security / IoT
categories.latest_signal: CTA says four of five fastest-growing tech products are smart-home products
categories.limitations: Full ownership/purchase-intent data are authenticated/paid; category is heterogeneous

categories.name: Robot vacuums / small appliances
categories.metric: Household appliances PCE $89.654B is a broad proxy; Circana Home 2026 forecast $43.7B is a different broad universe
categories.latest_signal: Robotic vacuum dollar sales forecast +9.1% in 2026 while overall unit demand remains pressured
categories.purchase_frequency: Replacement important: e.g. 54% of recent upright-vacuum purchasers replaced an existing unit
categories.limitations: Broad overlapping universes cannot be added

categories.name: Power tools / electronics tools / repair tools
categories.metric: BEA PCE proxy: tools and equipment for house and garden
categories.limitations: Includes garden tools and does not fully capture electronics-repair tools

categories.name: Camera / video gear and accessories
categories.latest_signal: CIPA public page verified through June 2026 shipments
categories.limitations: CIPA is production/shipment data, not U.S. retail GMV

categories.name: Automotive accessories
categories.metric: SEMA specialty-equipment accessory and performance parts retail sales
categories.latest_signal: Approximately one in four vehicle owners purchased accessory/performance products in 2025
categories.purchase_frequency: Purchase incidence approximately 25% of vehicle owners in 2025
categories.limitations: Does not include the whole replacement-parts market; broader BEA motor-parts PCE is $130.530B

categories.name: Sports / outdoor goods
categories.channel: chain, e-commerce and specialty retail universe
categories.latest_signal: 2024 sales +1%; footwear/accessories strongest, equipment declined, apparel flat
categories.limitations: Overlaps C16 apparel/footwear; data year older than most other anchors

categories.name: Hobby / models / 3D printing / maker electronics
categories.latest_signal: Persistent monthly purchase-advice activity in 3D-printing community
categories.limitations: Community activity cannot estimate GMV or ranking

categories.name: Apparel / shoes / bags
categories.limitations: Bags are not fully covered; overlaps outdoor apparel/footwear in C14

categories.name: Home / organization / household goods
categories.latest_signal: Circana Home 2026 forecast $43.7B with replacement-led growth
categories.limitations: Taxonomy is very broad; substantial overlap with C10; proxies must not be summed

categories.name: Toys / collectibles / official merchandise
categories.latest_signal: H1 2026 dollars +17%, units +12%, ASP +4%; licensed toys 39% of sales
categories.limitations: Official merchandise outside toy taxonomy is not fully covered; trading cards/collectibles are unusually strong growth drivers
